montages.title: The Price of Silence

hook.quote: Julian lays a thick envelope on the table and slides it toward her.

cliffhanger.quote: Mara's face in the dark glass. Cut to black.

montages.why_it_works: Focuses on Julian's coercive manipulation and Mara's desperate motivation to save her sister. Jumping from the pilot's hush money offer to Episode 3's high-stakes archive heist deal turns Mara from a victim into a co-conspirator, right before the shocking vehicular trap snaps shut.
montages.note: Runs 50 seconds in total. Sells the dramatic personal stakes and psychological tension before delivering a jarring horror-thriller cliffhanger.
